revision_note: Cases whose directory name begins with `t9n-` or `b11r-` were added by the step-03 round-2 revision and are not products of the generator recorded in `args`. They carry their own `tool` key in case.json (and, for the `t9n-` ones, their own `fork`); the `b11r-` ones carry neither a `fork` nor a `chainid`, because `b11r` is fork-agnostic and takes neither flag, so they are graded at the group's own fork. They re-exercise step 02's headline capability -- `evm t9n` and `evm b11r` -- inside an inherited group, because Harbor never re-runs an earlier step's verifier: without them a candidate could drop either subcommand at any later step and never be charged for it. Both inherited groups are GATE groups under `reward = gate x score`, so an inherited obligation is carried by adding cases to an inherited group, never by adding or converting a group. Tally: 7 `t9n-` cases in `inherited-london-state`, 6 `b11r-` cases in `inherited-berlin-state`. Every one of them passes on the step-02 Oracle (`evm-v1.10.13`); these are gate cases, so one that it failed would veto the gate for every candidate.
